scripts.env: sh -c 'test -f backend/.env && echo "backend/.env already exists, skipping" || (cp backend/.env.example backend/.env && echo "Created backend/.env")'
scripts.setup: pnpm run setup:backend && pnpm run setup:frontend
scripts.dev: pnpm run dev:backend & pnpm run dev:frontend & wait
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/uv-cache uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.db:init: cd backend && UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/uv-cache uv run python -c "import asyncio; from app.database import init_db; asyncio.run(init_db())"
scripts.db:admin-init: cd backend && UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/uv-cache uv run python bootstrap_admin.py
scripts.db:migrate: sh -c 'cd backend && UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/uv-cache uv run alembic revision --autogenerate -m "$1"' --
scripts.db:upgrade: cd backend && UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/uv-cache uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:downgrade: cd backend && UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/uv-cache uv run alembic downgrade -1
scripts.db:seed: cd backend && UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/uv-cache uv run python seed_skills.py
scripts.db:bootstrap: pnpm run db:upgrade && pnpm run db:admin-init && pnpm run db:seed
scripts.test: cd backend && UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/uv-cache uv run pytest -v
